_comment: LOCAL build manifest - the paths below are absolute for one checkout, so edit them before reusing. Force AUX as the default source. Step 1 of the plan in issue #72: a DATA edit only, so there is no code patch and nothing can be bricked. `supervisor.Last_Source` is the value C_MGR_SRC::StartUp() restores at boot (saved by C_MGR_SRC::ImmediateSourceSave()). AUX is position 4 per the 0-based source list in C_HMI_AUDIO_APP_BASE::GetSourceAtPosition(). If the unit ignores it, try varying supervisor.Last_Source_Priority (currently 1) alongside it. If 4 lands on the WRONG source, the position guess is wrong - report what it did land on and it can be corrected from a single flash rather than a guess.
